jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.167.5 to 1.167.6. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.167.5 to 1.167.6. In README.md change every 1.167.5 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.6. In these tests replace the 1.167.5 pin with 1.167.6 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.167.6 above the 1.167.5 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: Held tickets stay out of Needs you, and the first wide wave. And these bullets, each starting with a bold lead word: Board: tickets in review or todo status no longer leak into Needs you. Local lane: swarm tunnel add, status and remove manage an auto-reconnecting launchd SSH tunnel; a down tunnel pauses the endpoint. Scope: swarm scope gate --list and --fix-owners show and resolve the ticket-manager findings. Runner: cacheContext is never empty or stale; scratch cleanup cannot fail a finished job; the pre-push guard checks the pushed range; integrate flags outputs it did not write; ticket ids come in per-machine blocks (T-0179); decisions waiting over an hour also go out as a phone notification.
